What we do  ·  AI Assurance Can you prove it when asked?

Assurance comes down to what you can put on the table when a regulator, auditor or customer asks. We examine AI systems independently of whoever built them, and we never assess a system we built ourselves.

4–10 WEEKSEVIDENCE, NOT A POLICY DOCUMENTINDEPENDENT OF ANY SYSTEM WE BUILT
Why this pillar exists

Governance is judged on what it produced.

Every organization we meet has policies. Far fewer can quickly produce the artifacts, meaning records such as registers, approvals and test results, that show a decision was governed when it was taken.

01

The inventory is always partial

AI arrives as a feature of something already bought. It is running long before it appears on any register, and the register is the first thing asked for.

02

The decision record does not exist

This system was approved by someone. Reconstructing who, when and on what information, two years later, is expensive and rarely convincing.

03

The builder wrote the opinion

An assurance report written by the party that built the system will be read as a sales document. Independence is what gives it weight.

ORVIX
The boundary

We evaluate. The builder remediates.

Three steps. We test and re-test. The fix in between belongs to whoever built or runs the system, which keeps our findings independent.

STEP 01 · ORVIX

We test and write it down

We evaluate the system against what it was claimed to do and against the obligations that apply to you. We record what the test showed, including where no record exists.

STEP 02 · YOUR BUILDER

Your builder makes the fix

Whoever built or runs the system carries out the remediation. Keeping the fix with them means our next evaluation is still independent.

STEP 03 · ORVIX

We re-test on a cycle

We re-run the same tests on a schedule. An evaluation describes a configuration on a date, and configurations change.

Our findings never turn into build work for us. That keeps every finding a piece of evidence you can rely on.

Questions we are asked

Before you ask us.

Does Orvix build AI systems as well?
Yes, through our Applied AI & Data pillar. AI Assurance never evaluates a system Orvix built. Where one of ours needs an assurance opinion, an independent party gives it. That separation is what lets you rely on every finding here.
Does this lead to certification?
It prepares you for it. We produce the evidence and the gap register that a certification body, regulator or customer questionnaire will ask for, and we state up front which of those we are preparing you for. The certificate itself comes from an accredited certification body.
How fast can this be done?
A scoped review against one obligation typically runs four to eight weeks. The pace is usually set by how complete your inventory is on day one, which is why the inventory is where we start.

Start with the artifact you could not produce.

Bring the obligation you are most likely to be asked about. In thirty minutes we will tell you which rows you can already fill.
